messages:
alex: Quick heads up — ran the nightly perf matrix for fused-RoPE + paged-flash variants on A100.

alex: Setup: model=gpt-like-15B, seq_len=2048/4096, batch_sizes=1,8,16, kernels tried: flash_v2, flash_paged, fused_attn_v3 (rotdim-aware), fallback=rotary_slow.

alex: Observed ~12% p95 latency increase at batch 8 for seq_len=2048 using flash_paged with fused-RoPE enabled. CPU util on host stable, GPU sm_efficiency drops ~9%.

maria: can you paste the exact command + env? also the perf trace / nvprof output?

alex: sure, repro command:
```
EXPORT CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
python infra/bench/run_bench.py --model redwood/g15b --seq-len 2048 --batch 8 --kernels flash_paged,fused_attn_v3 --rope fused --profile /tmp/trace.nvprof
```

alex: attached nvprof snippet:
```
GPU activities: memcpy 4.2ms | cudamemcpy 0.1ms | kernels: fused_attn_v3 7.8ms (p95 up) | flash_paged_attn 6.9ms
```

dinesh: @alex did you try disabling rotary scaling? last week rotary-scale tweak regressed fusion path for >rotary_dim/2.

alex: yes — I tested with rotary_scale=1.0 (no scaling) and the regression disappeared (p95 back to baseline). So looks tied to scaling math in fused path.

jamie: interesting. Could be kernel selector choosing flash_paged when fused can't vectorize scaled RoPE, causing suboptimal launch config. Any kernel selector logs?

alex: pasted selector debug:
```
[selector] seq=2048 batch=8 -> prefer=flash_paged (score=0.83)
[selector] fused_attn_v3 score=0.79 (rotdim=64, scaled=true)
```

maria: hypothesis: fused_attn_v3 has math that depends on rotary_scale, when scale !=1 it disables some warp-level fused path, falling back to slower tiled path inside flash_paged. We should add a feature flag to prefer fused even if score slightly lower when rope=scaled.

dinesh: or adjust batching heuristic: for seq>1024 and batch>=4, prefer fused_attn_v3 if rotdim<=64 even if score delta<0.05. add perf test.

jamie: I'll add a selector config change and run matrix. @perf-bot can you schedule A100 nightly with selector overrides (force fused_attn_v3) and post results?

perf-bot: scheduled: night-run-177501-override-fused on a100. ETA 6h :gear: 

maria: also file a tiny repro that toggles rotary_scale in python so we can bisect kernel code quickly. alex can you open a PR with repro harness?

alex: will do. creating PR with minimal script that toggles rope scaling and dumps kernel choice traces + nvtx ranges. :eyes:

dinesh: good. If this is confirmed, plan: 1) add selector tweak, 2) fix fused math to preserve warp-fused path for scaled rope (likely a normalization step), 3) add unit test in kernel CI.

jamie: agreed. adding to eng-ml triage board. Thanks all :thumbsup:
